parts.name: Wheel
parts.Basic_description: A circular rubber wheel attached to the lower rear side of the trashcan, used for mobility.
parts.Functional_description: The wheel allows the trashcan to be easily moved or tilted for transportation.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around its axle to enable rolling motion.

parts.name: Wheel
parts.Basic_description: A second rubber wheel identical to the first, located on the opposite side of the trashcan base.
parts.Functional_description: It works in tandem with the first wheel to balance and support the trashcan during movement.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around its axle to enable rolling motion.

parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: A hinged plastic lid that covers the top opening of the trashcan.
parts.Functional_description: It prevents odors from escaping and keeps debris or rainwater from entering the bin.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about a hinge axis to open and close.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The main container body of the trashcan, made of durable plastic with integrated handles.
parts.Functional_description: It holds and contains waste materials, providing structural support for the lid and wheels.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary except when tilted or rolled using the wheels.
